# Inmo24x7

> WhatsApp assistant for real estate agencies (inmobiliarias) in Argentina. Using the official WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API), it answers every inquiry instantly, 24/7, asks what the person is looking for, shows properties from the agency's own catalog, and proposes visit times within the team's hours. The team gets an email, confirms the visit and closes the deal.

inmo24x7 es un servicio de José Luis Muzikant (CUIT 20-26474739-3), Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, Argentina.

## What it does today

- Answers WhatsApp instantly, 24/7, with the official WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API).
- Qualifies each lead: operation (buy or rent), area, rooms, budget, name and contact.
- Shows properties from the agency's catalog, loaded with a CSV/Excel spreadsheet or one by one.
- Proposes visit times within the team's hours and notifies the team to confirm the visit.
- Hands the conversation to a person on the team (email notification); "Responder yo" lets the team reply from the panel.
- Panel with the inquiries, each lead's status and basic weekly numbers.
- Customization: assistant name, tone and questions.
- Coming soon: a button for the agency's website.

Not offered: CRM or Google Sheets integrations, public API, lead scoring, WhatsApp notifications to the team, calendar integration, SLA.

## Getting started

Accounts are by invitation: write on WhatsApp or by email and we give access. The agency can use its current number or a new one; it is running the same day once the WhatsApp connection is approved.

## Pricing (launch)

- Prueba gratis: 14 days free, no card. Everything included, 1 WhatsApp number.
- Inmobiliaria: USD 49/month founder price for the first 10 agencies, kept for 12 months; regular price USD 79/month. 1 WhatsApp number (own or new), up to 1,000 conversations per month, unlimited property catalog, inquiries panel and "Responder yo", assistant customization, WhatsApp and email support.
- Varias sucursales: custom pricing for more numbers and several teams.

A conversation is a 24-hour session with the same person. Prices in USD, billed in Argentine pesos at the day's exchange rate. WhatsApp messages charged by Meta are billed separately, directly by Meta. Cancel anytime.
